mapper.select: SELECT scope_type, scope_value FROM t_auth_data_permission WHERE subject_type = 'USER' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND grant_source = 'FEISHU_POLICY' ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_auth_data_permission WHERE subject_type = 'USER' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND grant_source = 'FEISHU_POLICY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_data_permission ( subject_type, subject_id, scope_type, scope_value, access_level, effect, grant_source, source_ref ) VALUES ( 'USER', #{subjectId}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeValue}, 'READ', 'ALLOW', 'FEISHU_POLICY', 'APPROVED_POLICY' )
